foodtrucks:notification_open: The {vehicle} is open with {units} items. About {rate} customers an hour here right now, as long as someone is at the window.

foodtrucks:notification_open_unpaid: The stock in the {vehicle} isn't paid for yet.

foodtrucks:notification_data_readonly: Food Trucks data in this save is read-only.
foodtrucks:notification_paused: Nobody's at the {vehicle}'s window. Customers wait a while, then walk on.
foodtrucks:notification_closed_error: A sale failed. The {vehicle} closes: {sales} sales, {revenue}. See Player.log.
foodtrucks:notification_tick_failed: Food Trucks sales stopped after an error. See Player.log.

foodtrucks:notification_uninstall_partia: Removed {count} vehicles, refunded {refund}. Still in the save: {left}. Refunds not paid: {unpaid}. See Player.log.
foodtrucks:notification_no_delivery: General US Trucks doesn't deliver food carts or trucks. You'll have to take it with you.
foodtrucks:notification_open_no_data: Food Trucks data files didn't load. See Player.log.
foodtrucks:notification_open_no_equipmen: The {vehicle} can't open without any equipment installed.
foodtrucks:notification_open_too_much_eq: Too much equipment: a {vehicle} only fits {slots} pieces.
foodtrucks:notification_stock_full: Full: this vehicle holds {units} units of food (a coffee counts a quarter, a pastry half). The rest stays where it was.
foodtrucks:notification_equipment_full: No room: this vehicle fits {slots} pieces of equipment.
foodtrucks:legality_parking_lane: A cart can't set up in a parking lane. It belongs on the pavement.

foodtrucks:legality_subway: Too close to the subway entrance.
foodtrucks:notification_closed_no_equipm: The {vehicle} has no equipment installed and closes.

foodtrucks:notification_closed_licence: The vendor licence ran out. The {vehicle} closes: {sales} sales, {revenue}.

foodtrucks:dialog_city_no_course: The city only licenses vendors who have passed the Food Safety course.
foodtrucks:dialog_city_permit_no_licence: Vending permits are only issued to vendors with a valid licence.
foodtrucks:dialog_city_unavailable: Street vending can't be handled right now.
foodtrucks:message_city_licence_issued: Your vendor licence is valid until day {day}.

foodtrucks:legality_truck_hatch: The hatch faces the road. The truck has to stand with its hatch towards the pavement.
foodtrucks:notification_closed_no_licenc: Selling street food takes a vendor licence. The {vehicle} closes: {sales} sales, {revenue}.

foodtrucks:notification_routes_failed: Hired crews stopped after an error. See Player.log.
foodtrucks:notification_hire_indoors: The {vehicle} is parked indoors. Its crew waits for it out on the street.
